title: Analysis code and figure source data for "Contact-dependent intercellular dTMP transfer sustains tumor cell proliferation"
description: Selected analysis scripts and figure source data accompanying Contact-dependent intercellular dTMP transfer sustains tumor cell proliferation. Includes patient-level scRNA-seq cell-state analysis, Visium TYMS/TK1 neighborhoods, TCGA-LUAD summaries, human and mouse bulk RNA-seq source analysis, DepMap connexins, spatial cell-state abundance mapping and Kras/Trp53 amplicon analysis. Each analysis folder describes its inputs, methods, environment and QC. MIT applies to laboratory-authored software; third-party code and data retain their original terms as described in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
